description: Defines the QuicIdleNetworkDetector class for detecting handshake and idle network timeouts in QUIC connections, including related delegate interface and internal state management.

classes.name: quic::QuicIdleNetworkDetector
classes.description: Detects handshake timeout and idle network timeout, manages detection alarms, and notifies delegate on events.

classes.name: quic::QuicIdleNetworkDetector::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callbacks related to handshake timeout, idle network detection, and bandwidth update timeout.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector
methods.description: Constructor initializing detector with delegate, current time, arena, alarm factory, and context.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Handles alarm events for timeout detection.

methods.name: SetTimeouts
methods.description: Sets handshake and idle network timeouts.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Updates state when a packet is sent.

methods.name: OnPacketReceived
methods.description: Updates state when a packet is received.

methods.name: enable_shorter_idle_timeout_on_sent_packet
methods.description: Enables shorter idle timeout after sending a packet.

methods.name: time_of_last_received_packet
methods.description: Returns the time of the last received packet.

methods.name: last_network_activity_time
methods.description: Returns the most recent network activity time.

methods.name: idle_network_timeout
methods.description: Returns the idle network timeout duration.

methods.name: bandwidth_update_timeout
methods.description: Returns the bandwidth update timeout duration.

methods.name: GetIdleNetworkDeadline
methods.description: Calculates and returns the deadline for idle network detection.

methods.name: SetAlarm
methods.description: Sets or resets the internal alarm based on current state.

methods.name: MaybeSetAlarmOnSentPacket
methods.description: Adjusts alarm timing after sending a packet.

methods.name: GetBandwidthUpdateDeadline
methods.description: Calculates the deadline for bandwidth update alarms.
